moon_base/all.explanation: SAFFIRE-II [PSI-99] ranks first (84.8/100) and SAFFIRE-I [PSI-98] ranks second (84.3/100) because both match the scenario's ventilated airflow (15/15), test solid habitat materials (20/20), cover the prevention pillar (14/20), and achieve maximum richness scores (10/10). FLEX-2 [PSI-68] ranks third (77.0/100) with a perfect oxygen score (35/35) because the 30% scenario falls within its tested 17–30% O₂ range and its tested pressure range (7.3–44.1 psi) covers the 10.2 psi scenario, though it scores lower on materials (4/20) by testing liquid droplet fuels rather than habitat materials.

iss_cabin/all.explanation: SAFFIRE-I [PSI-98] ranks first with a 93.4/100 total score by earning high points for testing oxygen levels near the 21% scenario (34.4/35), full points for ventilated airflow matching the scenario (15/15), maximum scores for habitat solid fuel materials (20/20), and full richness points (10/10). SAFFIRE-II [PSI-99] ranks second with the same 93.4/100 total score, sharing identical high marks for oxygen, ventilated airflow, habitat materials, and data richness. BASS-II [PSI-25] ranks third with 82.0/100, achieving a full 35/35 points because its oxygen range covers the 21% scenario, 20/20 for habitat materials, and 17/20 for covering two pillars, but receiving 0/15 points because its airflow was not reported.

spacesuit/all.explanation:
SAFFIRE-I [PSI-98] ranks highest with a total score of 49.0/100 because it achieves full points in material (20/20) and richness (10/10) by evaluating solid habitat fuels across 4 test rows with 5 measurement types, alongside points for covering the prevention pillar (14/20) and airflow (5/15). 

SAFFIRE-II [PSI-99] ties with a 49.0/100 total by matching those exact material (20/20), richness (10/10), pillar (14/20), and flow (5/15) scores while testing materials like cotton, Nomex, PMMA, silicone, and SIBAL across 15 test rows. 

SAFFIRE-III [PSI-100] ranks third with a 49/100 total score, securing the same high marks for material (20/20), richness (10/10), the prevention pillar (14/20), and ventilated airflow (5/15) using 2 test rows and 5 measurement types.

moon_base/detection.explanation: Ranked first with a total score of 65/100, [PSI-101] leads because it covers the detection focus, matches the ventilated scenario airflow, tests habitat solid fuels, and achieves maximum data richness with 109 test rows and 5 measurement types. Ranked second, [PSI-102] (64/100) matches [PSI-101] across the detection focus, ventilated airflow, and habitat material categories, but receives a slightly lower score due to having 8 test rows and 4 measurement types. Ranked third, [PSI-60] (28/100) still covers the detection focus, but ranks lower overall because its airflow is unreported, its gaseous fuels include no named habitat materials, and it lacks an experimental table.
